CREATE TABLE printer_accounting_authority (
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	device_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at TEXT, 
	printer_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	mode TEXT NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_sha256 TEXT, 
	legacy_writer_disabled_at TEXT, 
	reconciled_at TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_printer_accounting_authority PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_printer_accounting_authority_revision_valid CHECK (typeof(revision) = 'integer' AND revision >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_printer_accounting_authority_times_valid CHECK (length(created_at) = 27 AND length(updated_at) = 27), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_printer_accounting_authority_time_order CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_printer_accounting_authority_deletion_time CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_printer_accounting_authority_mode_enum CHECK (mode IN ('REVIEW_ONLY', 'LEGACY_ACTIVE', 'CUTOVER_READY', 'UFM_ACTIVE')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_printer_accounting_authority_snapshot_digest_format CHECK (snapshot_sha256 IS NULL OR (length(snapshot_sha256) = 64 AND snapshot_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_printer_accounting_authority_cutover_evidence_required CHECK (mode NOT IN ('CUTOVER_READY', 'UFM_ACTIVE') OR (snapshot_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND legacy_writer_disabled_at IS NOT NULL AND reconciled_at IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_printer_accounting_authority_evidence_time_order CHECK ((legacy_writer_disabled_at IS NULL OR legacy_writer_disabled_at >= created_at) AND (reconciled_at IS NULL OR reconciled_at >= created_at)), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_printer_accounting_authority_printer_id UNIQUE (printer_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_printer_accounting_authority_device_id_device_identity FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES device_identity (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_printer_accounting_authority_printer_id_printer FOREIGN KEY(printer_id) REFERENCES printer (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)
